newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends down, but holds most Friday's gains.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends down, but holds most Friday's gains.

text.p: IPE Brent futures ended slightly lower on Monday, but most traders said some negative consolidation was to be expected given the strength of Friday's gains.
July Brent settled 19 cents lower at $20.17 a barrel, having posted an 86 cents gain on Friday after insitutional funds stepped into the market giving it a long awaited boost upward.
"The contract has held up pretty well. The close above $20 is very encouraging," one trader said.
Traders noted, however, that Monday's session had been fairly quiet due to the absence of many European players due to public holidays across most of Europe.
"I think the upward trend is basically intact for the time being, but it will be interesting to see what happens when the rest of Europe comes back tomorrow," said another trader.
June gas oil, meanwhile, closed some $4.75 up at $177.75 a tonne as the market played catch-up with crude's gains on Friday.
"It has to be said that most of Europe is out of the market today so it's quite easy to move around," said a gas oil player. "Even so the overall trend appears to be up. I wouldn't go home short."
